title: A second version of the Olsson-Laszlo boundedness lemma for a morphism of ringed sites
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file sites-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma is a second version, with slightly changed hypotheses, of the Olsson-Laszlo boundedness statement for a morphism of ringed sites: under the two Olsson-Laszlo situations and the vanishing of the higher direct images above a fixed degree, the cohomology sheaves of the derived pushforward agree with those of the pushforward of a sufficiently negative truncation in degrees at least N - n (statement lines 5875-5895). The proof is a complete derived limit argument: the complex and its pushforward are written as derived limits of truncations (proof lines 5899-5902); evaluating at a cofinal system of coverings and using the dimension bound in the second situation shows that the relevant cohomology groups are eventually constant, independently of the truncation index (proof lines 5903-5912); and the description of the cohomology of a derived limit, applied in two consecutive degrees, together with the long exact sequence of the truncation triangle, yields the asserted isomorphism (proof lines 5913-5963). The non-formal content is the derived limit bookkeeping and the use of the dimension bound to obtain constancy. The claim is H2: a structured reduction with each input and each degree estimate named.
